verdict.rationale: Docusign is a SaaS agreement platform, so data portability is a fair axis. The evidence gives only indirect, programmatic access paths: a REST API, official SDKs built from published OpenAPI specs, and an MCP server that can 'retrieve agreement context and metadata.' Together these imply a user could pull data out with custom work, but nothing documents an actual export feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/account-wide export, exports in open formats (e.g. PDF/A, CSV, JSON of envelopes and audit trails), an offboarding/account-closure data portability process, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a full export is achievable.
